22, ANNOUNCEMENTS/REPORTS/MOTIONS:
a) Designation of Official Voting Delegate and Alternate Delegate for the City of
Cheyenne at the June 8, 2023 Wyoming Association of Municipalities Summer
Convention Business Meeting to be held in Cody, Wyoming.

Dr. Aldrich moved to designate Dr. Rinne as the Official Voting Delegate and Mayor Collins as
the Alternate Voting Delegate, seconded by Mr. Esquibel.

Kris Jones, City Clerk, provided a staff report.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Finance Committee, the meeting
was adjourned at 1:00 p.m.

Submitted by,
GUC Mink

Jennifer McClelland
Executive Assistant to the City Council
